title: Attack surface reduction exclusions are broad

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy contains', 'policies contain')} broad attack surface reduction exclusions

messages.businessImpact: A broad exclusion disables the protection for a whole path or process family, which is usually wider than the application that prompted it.
remediation: Narrow each exclusion to the specific executable or path that needs it.
